mapper.sql: id, conversation_no, user_id, title, status, entry_point, context_object_type, context_object_id, summary_text, last_run_no, last_message_time, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_conversation (conversation_no, user_id, title, status, entry_point, context_object_type, context_object_id, summary_text, last_run_no, last_message_time, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by) VALUES (#{conversationNo}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{entryPoint}, #{contextObjectType}, #{contextObjectId}, #{summaryText}, #{lastRunNo}, #{lastMessageTime}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (#{includeArchived} = TRUE OR status = 'ACTIVE') ORDER BY last_message_time DESC, create_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_conversation SET last_run_no = #{lastRunNo}, summary_text = #{summaryText}, last_message_time = #{lastMessageTime}, edit_time = #{editTime}, edit_by = #{editBy} WHERE id = #{id}
